note: Work: Labour Code (Law No. 2004-017 of 6 July 2004), Article 153, read in the copy the Ministry of Finance publishes in its compilation of texts: children may not be employed in any undertaking, even as apprentices, before 14, or after it while still subject to compulsory schooling; children of 12 may, on Article 154's conditions, be employed where members of their family work (not in sea fishing). The Code makes no exception for performers in these articles, so a performer under 14 is held as barred (a reading, not the law's word). Law No. 2022-025 amending the Code (same compilation) was read and doesn't touch Article 153. Majority and service: not read; the Personal Status Code and any law on military service weren't reached.

sources.title: Ministère des Finances, Recueil des textes : Loi n° 2004-017 portant Code du travail
sources.said: Article 153 : Age d’admission au travail Les enfants ne peuvent être employés dans aucune entreprise, même comme apprentis avant l’âge de 14 ans ou si, ayant dépassé cet âge, ils sont encore soumis à l’obligation scolaire.
